comparator.name: Business Administration
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme and route pages establish a 180-EC Business Administration curriculum: a 60-EC common first year, a 60-EC second-year Business and Management specialisation and a 60-EC third year comprising 30 EC of genuine minor or exchange space, four named 5-EC courses and a 10-EC thesis. The generic target offers Accountancy and Controlling, Business and Management, and Technology Management. Business and Management is selected before UCR construction because it preserves the programme's broadest general management identity; the other two are narrower professional or technology specialisations. The 30-EC minor or exchange remains explicit rather than being filled with invented content.
components: Genuine third-year minor or exchange space preserved without invented content.

alternatives.label: Business, organisations & management
alternatives.concept: The closest feasible UCR response to Groningen's Business and Management route: a broad business-administration programme combining strategy, entrepreneurship, accounting, finance, economics, marketing, organisational behaviour, leadership, research, data, technology and international governance. UCR does not reproduce the comparator's dedicated operations, supply-chain, management-accounting or thesis sequence.
alternatives.labelReason: The label names the programme's own broad academic organising fields and does not borrow Groningen's specialisation title as a claim of equivalence.
progression: Business, economics, data and research foundations precede advanced strategy, law, leadership, econometrics and market research; all formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternatives.label: Technology, data & digital business
alternatives.concept: A distinct business route generated by Groningen's Technology Management specialisation and its digital-business and operations evidence. It combines programming, databases, mathematics, algorithms, machine learning and AI ethics with strategy, organisations, marketing, economics and responsible international business. It is a UCR technology-and-data route, not a substitute for Groningen's dedicated production, logistics and operations-information-systems sequence.
alternatives.labelReason: The label states the actual UCR organising fields and avoids presenting the route as Groningen's formal Technology Management specialisation.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the broad closest match, this route replaces substantial leadership, communication, finance and entrepreneurship content with programming, databases, linear algebra, probability, algorithms, machine learning, deep learning and AI ethics. Eight of 24 courses differ, and technology and data become the organising logic.
progression: Business, programming, data, research and mathematical foundations precede advanced strategy, algorithms, machine learning, deep learning, international business and market research. Mathematical Methods precedes linear algebra, probability and deep learning; programming precedes algorithms. All formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternatives.label: Finance, accounting & business decisions
alternatives.concept: A distinct route generated by Groningen's Accountancy and Controlling specialisation and its finance, accounting, audit and control evidence. UCR combines accounting and corporate finance with banking, economics, econometrics, probability, data science, programming and optimisation for evidence-based business decisions, while acknowledging that it offers no dedicated auditing, taxation or management-control sequence.
alternatives.labelReason: The label names UCR's available accounting, finance and decision-analysis content without claiming professional accountancy or controlling preparation.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the broad closest match, this route substitutes mathematics, programming, databases, optimisation, probability and additional economics and finance for much of the leadership, marketing and communication content. It differs from the closest match by nine courses and from the technology route by six, so both pairwise differences exceed 30 EC and reflect the evidenced finance-and-control organising logic.
progression: Programming and mathematical methods precede decision algorithms, linear algebra and probability; economics and research foundations precede advanced economics, econometrics, finance and market research, with all formal prerequisites completed earlier and all courses offered in their assigned terms.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target is the generic Business Administration bachelor. Of its three current specialisations, Business and Management is the broadest general route across strategy, organisation, people, operations and markets; Accountancy and Controlling and Technology Management are narrower specialist routes. It is therefore selected under the neutral broad-academic-identity rule, independently of UCR fit.

selection.assessment: The closest programme covers Groningen's broad business-administration and Business and Management core. Two further formal specialisations are generator-backed and support coherent UCR responses: a technology, data and digital-business route and a finance, accounting and decision-analysis route. Pairwise differences are 60 EC, 67.5 EC and 45 EC; all exceed the 30-EC floor and reflect different academic organising logics. The maximum of three alternatives is reached.

notes.text: Both curricula address organisations, strategy, economics, accounting, marketing, people, digital change and empirical research. Groningen additionally requires dedicated operations, supply-chain, management-accounting, management-control, research-design and thesis components. UCR offers coherent business, technology-and-data and finance-and-decision routes, but does not reproduce every specialist functional sequence or the separate Business and Management thesis.
